steps.title: Check your own two emails before you send them anywhere.
steps.model: Inviting: Are you free on…? · Are you doing anything on…? · Would you like to…? · Do you fancy… -ing ?

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ check whether somebody is free — Are you free that week? Are you doing anything on Friday?
✓ invite two ways — Would you like to meet? and Do you fancy meeting?
✓ accept warmly — That’d be lovely. Sounds great. That works for me.
✓ refuse in three parts — the apology, the reason, the alternative
✓ suggest another time — How about…? Is Sunday any good? Shall we say…?
✓ write a short invitation and a short reply, and hear the difference in register
